desc: Prove that marginal costs for each product are \(P_i,3P_i,5P_i,\ldots\), and that selecting the globally cheapest marginals minimizes cost for any fixed unit count.
Derive the threshold-counting formulas and exact handling of ties, including the next marginal cost after all marginals \(\le T\).
Establish safe binary-search bounds and ensure all intermediate arithmetic is efficient and exact under the constraints.
Implement the threshold algorithm in Python with fast input and \(O(N\log M)\) complexity.
Validate the implementation on both samples and edge cases such as \(N=1\), equal prices, \(M<P_i\), and exact budget exhaustion.
